All targeted frontend features PASS. Chat.jsx hideHeader bug from iter13 is fixed; /chat now renders and streams replies for signed-in admin without the mesh error. Signed-in admin sees NO guest banner/sidebar. Attach menu contains exactly Upload/Image/Video. Builder generated 'a one-button color changer' in ~30s, iframe rendered, publish produced live URL that serves 7KB HTML with HTTP 200. Voice engine reports whisper-small; speak+transcribe round-trip works via /api/voice/transcribe multipart 'file'.
